correctness.rationale: Exact binomial locality makes the global operator a block sum; ordered pivot coefficients give a nonzero determinant for each K. The explicit Chebyshev inverse is proved coefficientwise; its alternating coefficients have ℓ¹-norm |T_j(i)|=[(1+√2)^j+(-1)^j(1+√2)^{-j}]/2. Frobenius and a reflected-coordinate witness give matching upper/lower K-th-root bounds, while matrix norm is between 1 and √(2K). Exact rational checker tests K<=7 without claiming to certify the limit.

value.rationale: Space-time trade-off is a motivated issue in lattice graph sampling. This gives a complete, critical-density frame for every ℓ² signal with a local inverse and a sharp algebraic exponential stability penalty. The precise constant quantitatively distinguishes mere reconstruction from noise robustness and supplies a natural exact benchmark, rather than a relabelled special case or arbitrary finite sample.
